text:
marta: Noticing a gap: several customer invoices show credits in Stripe but NetSuite import shows 0 new credit memos for the same window (2026-03-22 23:00-23:45).
marta: Triggering upstream alert: billing-report job finished with status=success but revenue delta is +$0 when it should be negative for these accounts.
josh: Which job run id? and any logs from the NS importer?
marta: job id billing-report-2026-03-22-23-agg. NS importer logs show: "skipping event: filter mismatch (source!=webhook)" for ~85 events.
rachel: Wait, why would the importer filter on source? Backfills set source=backfill to avoid duplicate ingestion historically. Did we change the filter?
netsuite-bot: ingestion: processed_events=342 skipped=85 reason=source_tag_mismatch
billing-bot: stripe events: credit_note.created x85 (meta: job=backfill-2026-03-22)
emily: This looks like an intended safeguard that became a footgun when we retrofitted backfill events. The importer only accepted events where payload.origin=="webhook" to prevent manual CSV dupes. Backfill should have origin="backfill" but then we need a mapping path.
josh: Immediate steps: 1) pause downstream posting to GL; 2) re-run importer in dry-run with source whitelist for backfill job id; 3) produce list of affected customer ids + amounts.
marta: I've paused GL job: kubectl scale deployment gl-poster --replicas=0 -n prod.
rachel: I'll prepare a one-time import config to allow origin in (webhook, backfill) but require matching metadata.backfill_job==billing-backfill-2026-03-22 for safety. We'll also mark records with imported_via=backfill.
emily: Also audit for duplicates: if some backfill runs retried, Stripe might have created multiple credit_notes for same invoice. Check stripe metadata.invoice_id uniqueness before importing.
josh: Good call. I'll query: SELECT invoice_id, count(*) FROM stripe_credit_notes WHERE metadata->>'job'='backfill-2026-03-22' GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING count(*)>1;
marta: CS already seeing customers ask why statements changed. Can we get a short note for them explaining we're reconciling and not issuing refunds until we confirm?
rachel: Draft: "We're investigating unexpected credits caused by a billing backfill. Our finance team is reconciling records and will notify impacted customers within 48 hours. No refunds or collections changes will be made until reconciliation completes."
emily: Ops note: for next deploy we should make importer filtering configurable and log a sample payload for skipped events to speed triage. Opened ticket: FIN-2026-17.
josh: Action items: - rachel: run controlled import and tag records (ETA 40m) - emily: run duplicate detection in Stripe and flag conflicting credit_notes - marta: coordinate CS comms and hold any manual ledger adjustments - josh: audit job config change that added the strict origin filter.
marta: Uploaded affected list: drive.redwood.com/finance/missed_backfill_credits_2026-03-22.csv
emily: Thx. Keep GL paused until we confirm. Also revert any deploy that added the strict origin check if it's recent.
josh: I'll check deploy history and post findings here in 15m.
rachel: If import resumes, we'll set a short TTL lock per invoice_id to prevent simultaneous import attempts.
marta: Sounds good. Marking priority P0 for finance ops.
emily: Adding a postmortem template item: why backfill events were not given a safe import tag, and ensure backfill job attaches "import_hint=backfill" metadata next time.
